parts.html: The K-18 standard model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in a restrained gray: clean geometry, solid-color laminated chipboard fronts, and well-thought-out storage.
Neutral gray pairs easily with light walls, wood, stone, decorative plaster, and contemporary flooring, while the solid-color fronts keep the interior from feeling cluttered.

The model’s defining feature is its 4.8-linear-meter L-shaped layout. Cabinets, work surfaces, and built-in appliances run along two adjacent walls, leaving the rest of the floor area free — for a dining area, for example.
A cargo pull-out provides storage. Muller soft-close hinges close the doors gently, and the drawers glide out on concealed Muller runners.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included with the model. Lift-up mechanisms are not included.
We will make the K-18 to fit your room — with different cabinet dimensions, a different number of storage systems, and another front shade.
